episodes.207351: A strong cold front moved through the region during the early morning hours of October 27th with a secondary front on October 29th. A tornadic waterspout developed offshore of Mexico Beach and moved onshore as a tornado during the early morning hours off October 27th.  Gusty winds occurred with the frontal passage on October 29th.
